description: Cemu controllerProfiles/<Name>.xml is produced from the previous owner's reference profile (targets: cemu[].reference) because Cemu's internal button-id numbering is not documented on disk. <uuid>/<display_name> are set to the captured wheel (the reference used the SysKeyboard GUID 6f1d2b61-..., which only worked through Cemu's display-name fallback). DirectInput button ids < 32 are translated through 'referenceButtons' (owner's G29 layout); ids >= 32 are Cemu axis/hat codes and are kept, which is only correct when the captured wheel has the reference axis layout (wheel X, gas Y, brake Rz) - the generator checks this and warns otherwise.
